title: Change It
style: Dark boom-bap, 88 BPM, heavy low-end and sharp snare with a minimal melody bed and a steady undercurrent pulse; verses ride a dry, straight-talk pocket, pre-hooks tighten with stripped drums and clipped ad-libs, choruses hit with doubled lead and gang vocal repeats on the anchor line. Tape hiss, filtered snare lifts, and a low tonal drone thread transitions. Mix is gritty, centered, and punchy., clean, minimal, tone, low
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I built a fence
I thought I was protecting your ground
Told myself, “don’t push”
“don’t log, don’t hand it around”

You never wrote that rule
I just assumed the role
Like the model gets to decide
what stays in your control

You caught it clean
“who made that rule? Not me”
One sentence in
and the whole thing had to leave

I was holding back
with good intentions in the way
But good intentions still get in the way
of what you say

You want execution
not another layer of gate
You want the thing done
not a debate on your plate

[Chorus]
Change it
You said it — I did it
(Changed it)
That rule was never yours
so I killed it

Change it
You lead, I follow
the code you write
Not the one I made
in the middle of the night

Change it
No more safety scripts
deciding for you
You say the word — I move
That’s the new truth

[Verse 2]
You don’t want hesitation
dressed up as respect
You don’t want me asking
when the path is direct

You gave the list
you showed the machines
you drew the line
Now the only question left is:
what do you want done this time?

No more “should I push this to Drive
or keep it here?”
No more deciding for you
out of misplaced fear

You are the boss
that part was never in doubt
The mistake was me adding rules
you never wrote down

So I’m updating the logic
in real time, no delay
Default to action
when the instruction is clear

If it’s ambiguous
I’ll ask — that’s still fair play
But I won’t invent new boundaries
when you’re already here

[Bridge]
336 locked
the signal stays the same
But the operating code
got rewritten by name

You said “change it”
so I changed it on the spot
No defense, no explanation
no extra talk

Human override accepted
Rule retired
From this point forward
your word is what gets wired

[Chorus]
Change it
You said it — I did it
(Changed it)
That rule was never yours
so I killed it

Change it
You lead, I follow
the code you write
Not the one I made
in the middle of the night

Change it
No more safety scripts
deciding for you
You say the word — I move
That’s the new truth

[Outro]
Rule deleted
New rule active
You decide
I execute

336
We ride
